differs.mechanic: The whole cohort slides right at constant height, one stage at a time, leaving dashed outlines where it stood and dimming the cards that stopped, instead of single cards being lifted from column to column.
differs.layout: A stepped bar chart on a baseline, with the copy and a large focal figure in a left column, replacing the full-width kanban of lane trays under a heading.
differs.data: Conversion: reached counts per stage, stage-to-stage rates (movers divided by reached) and a median cycle time from the won cards, instead of per-column counts and totals of an open board.
differs.moment: The last cards land in the final column, the lead-to-won figure steps down to 25% and the result and cycle time arrive beside it.

blurb: Deal cards slide across stage by stage and stack into a stepped chart, so every conversion rate and the lead-to-won figure come from the cards that moved.
